entries.title: Bell bronze (copper-tin bell metal)

tiers.everyday: Bell bronze is a hard alloy of about four parts copper to one part tin. The tin makes the metal ring, but too much makes the bell brittle and likely to crack.
tiers.student: Bell metal is a high-tin bronze: the CCCBR gives around 80% copper and 20% tin. Alloying makes the metal harder, more rigid and more elastic than either metal alone. Too much tin makes it brittle and prone to cracking. It is melted at about 1,100 °C for casting. The Liberty Bell's NPS analysis is about 70% copper and 25% tin with traces of other metals.
